notes.query_counting: Query count tracked via postgres.js debug hook attached at client creation.
notes.A3: query_count_median: 101 — Drizzle has no dataloader, each user lookup in loop is a separate query (intentional N+1).
notes.A4: query_count_median: 1 — innerJoin resolves in single query.
notes.B1: query_count_median: 1 — chain of innerJoins across 4 tables in single query.
notes.B3: query_count_median: 1 — innerJoin on productTags junction table with category in single query.
notes.C2: Uses db.execute(sql`...`) with UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000. Drizzle update() does not support LIMIT. See methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json.
notes.D1: query_count_median: 5 — 1 SELECT products + 1 INSERT order + 1 INSERT items (batch) + 1 DELETE items + 1 DELETE order.

A1.description: Simple SELECT by primary key via select().from().where().limit(1)

A2.description: Filtered list with ORDER BY and LIMIT via select().from().where().orderBy().limit()

A3.description: N+1 diagnostic — 100 orders, sequential user lookup per order (intentional)

A4.description: Eager loading via innerJoin(users) — orders with users in single query

B1.description: Deep eager load via chain of innerJoins — Order → Items → Product → Category in single query

B2.description: Aggregate with GROUP BY via count() and avg() — categories with product count and avg price

B3.description: Many-to-many via innerJoin(productTags) with innerJoin(categories) — single query

C1.description: Bulk insert — 10,000 products in chunks of 500 via insert().values()

C2.description: Bulk update — db.execute(sql) UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000 rows (see methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json)

D1.description: Unit of Work — explicit inserts: order + batch items, 5 queries total
